literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe a single construct: PANX3-HA, in which the C-terminal FLAG tag of the Origene PS100001 vector was replaced by an HA tag. The PANX3 C-terminus (residues 289–392) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. The tag therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface, and does not qualify as a surface tag site. No other insertion — epitope, fluorescent protein, transposon, or domain insertion — at any extracellular position of PANX3 or a close ortholog appears in the ledger. The two extracellular loops (EL1: 60–108; EL2: 233–267) are entirely unsupported by any ledger line. Zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA tag (replacing FLAG from Origene PS100001 vector) appended after the last residue P392, which lies in the intracellular C-terminal domain (residues 289–392); L1 confirms predominantly intracellular localization of the tagged construct.
